card.title: Nintendo Switch PI3USB and Ferrite Filter Checks for HDMI Docking Issues

source.title: Nintendo Switch Docking and PI3USB Troubleshooting Guide

claims.statement: Check the coils, they should have continuity in parallel but not in cross (check each one)
claims.evidence: Annotated board view showing ferrite filters near the USB-C / video output area.

claims.statement: If no image on HDMI docking - Check 3v is getting to the PI3USB.
claims.evidence: Text instruction accompanying the board view.

claims.statement: Check around the passives around PI3USB. In particular the ferrite filters. These aren't the strongest! Bell them with a meter / check impedance / continuity is uniform with all of them
claims.evidence: Highlighted ferrite filters in the board diagram.

cautions: Check the coils, they should have continuity in parallel but not in cross (check each one)
Check around the passives around PI3USB. In particular the ferrite filters. These aren't the strongest!
card.caveats: Specific voltage and resistance values are not given in numbers; instructions rely on continuity and uniformity checks.
